warning.title: 🚫 DO NOT POST IN THIS CHANNEL
warning.text:
This channel catches **hacked accounts** that spam links in every channel.

Anyone who posts here is **removed from the server automatically**, and their messages from the last hour are deleted.

*Staff are not affected. If this happened to you by mistake, ask a member for a new invite.*

dm.title: ⚠️ Your Discord account may be hacked
dm.text:
A message was just sent from your account in **#{channel}** on **{server}**, a channel nobody should post in. Accounts that do this are almost always hacked, so you were removed from that server and your messages there from the last hour were deleted.

**What to do now**
1. Change your Discord password.
2. Turn on two-factor authentication (User Settings → My Account).
3. Check User Settings → Devices and log out anything you don't recognise.
4. Ask a member of **{server}** for a new invite to rejoin.

If you posted there yourself by mistake, just ask for an invite. You are not banned.
